name: Jada
title: Descendant of Judah
summary: Jada was a son of Onam and grandson of Jerahmeel, from the tribe of Judah. He is mentioned in 1 Chronicles in the genealogies of Judah. He had two sons, Jether and Jonathan, and his brother was named Shammai.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned in the genealogy of Judah
keyEvents.description: Jada is listed as a son of Onam in the genealogies of the tribe of Judah in 1 Chronicles.

keyEvents.title: The sons of Jada
keyEvents.description: The sons of Jada were Jether and Jonathan. Jether died without children.

keyEvents.title: The lineage of Jerahmeel
keyEvents.description: Jada belonged to the lineage of Jerahmeel, an important branch of the tribe of Judah. Jerahmeel was the firstborn son of Hezron.

keyEvents.title: Descendants of Jonathan
keyEvents.description: Jonathan, a son of Jada, had sons named Pelet and Sasa, who continued the family line.
